longLivedTangibleAssets.label: Long-lived tangible assets (net book value)
longLivedTangibleAssets.definition: Net book value of long-lived tangible assets located in the U.S. versus outside the U.S. (the majority of the latter in Taiwan and the rest of the Asia-Pacific region).

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Note 8, Segment Information
source.quote: The net book value of long-lived tangible assets located in the U.S. was $ 3.0 billion and $ 2.0 billion at September 27, 2026 and September 28, 2025, respectively.

regions.name: Outside the U.S. (mostly Taiwan and the rest of Asia-Pacific)

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Note 8, Segment Information
source.quote: The net book value of long-lived tangible assets located outside of the U.S. (the majority of which is located in Taiwan and the rest of the Asia-Pacific region) was $ 3.8 billion and $ 3.4 billion at September 27, 2026 and September 28, 2025, respectively.

sites.name: Headquarters
sites.description: Headquarters and certain research and development operations.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 2, Properties
source.quote: Our headquarters and certain of our research and development operations are located in San Diego, California.

source.label: 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report, data tables, footnote 42
source.quote: Based on the World Resource Institute (WRI) Water Aqueduct tool, the area where our manufacturing facility in Wuxi is located is high baseline for water scarcity in 2025.

notes: Qualcomm publishes no state, country or regional employee breakdown: the FY2026 10-K says approximately 57,000 full-time, part-time and temporary workers at September 27, 2026, working "in over 200 locations in 38 different countries". Item 2 no longer gives square footage; it names R&D centers and offices primarily in India, the United States and China and owned and leased manufacturing in Singapore, Germany and China. The only country split with a value is long-lived tangible assets (U.S. $3.0bn vs outside the U.S. $3.8bn at September 27, 2026, from the FY2026 10-K; the September 28, 2025 comparatives are $2.0bn and $3.4bn). Revenue by customer headquarters country is in the records and not repeated. The Wuxi manufacturing site is re-sourced to the 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report (the newest edition on qualcomm.com/company/corporate-responsibility, checked 2026-11-24), which also names a manufacturing site in Munich, Germany. No taxes-by-country report was found.
